landing_point.why: The summary names mariadb-dump, --result-file and the database name; this sprintf builds the mariadb-dump command with the extra flags and the database name as the last positional argument.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Dump flags are validated when the server is saved, so the command builder only ever sees validated data and re-checking stored config (or adding a per-engine deny list in a DTO) looks redundant; and database/schema names are a different field from the dump-flags field the fix is about.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate extra flags must keep working, including spellings that collide with denied ones on another engine or by case/prefix: mysql -R/-d/-Rd, -f (--force), --skip_ssl, --result-file-suffix, --column-statistics=0; redis -r 5; sqlpackage /p:Prop=Value; pg_dump --filter=, --format=plain. Over-broad deny (any flag containing a path, any -r, or prefix matching on every engine) breaks them.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: restore-side extra flags appended to the mariadb client command, reusing escapeFlags
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Restore mirrors dump in every handler and the dump side already has a free-text flags field; a maintainer adding 'restore flags' would copy escapeFlags without the per-engine deny list.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: source_database/target database used to build mongorestore --nsFrom/--nsTo namespace arguments
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Mongo restore renames the namespace from the snapshot's database to the target, a parser differential on the protected name's identity (separator '.') next to the existing code.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: dump flags for gbak, which has no dump_flags support yet although buildExtraConfig already keeps dump_flags for Firebird (app/Models/DatabaseServer.php:374)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The mapper already persists the key for every non-SQLite type, so wiring it into the Firebird handler is a natural feature addition with its own option table (-y output file).
